Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
The petitioner is seeking initiation of contempt proceedings against the respondents for wilful disobedience of the directions passed by this Court vide order dated 16.01.2019 in WP(C) 259/2015.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents is present.

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the respondent, however, submits that a notice under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act is still subsisting.
Evidently, no proceedings have been initiated in terms of Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act.
The only prayer of the petitioner is that the land is intended to be transferred for which an NOC is required.
Unhesitatingly, the respondent cannot sit over the matter in such manner and be allowed to flout the directions of this Court.
7. Learned counsel for the respondent requests for time to seek instructions.
Let instructions be availed within 15 days from today.
8. If required, additional counter affidavit may be also filed further giving details of the salary account of the official concerned.
9. Renotify on 08.08.2024.

DHARMESH SHARMA, J.
JULY 09, 2024 VLD
